core_obligations: Set up the criterion and the basic computations (proof lines 23659-23670): the lemma is proved through the h-criterion, using that H^i_{fppf}(X, O^{perf}) = colim_F H^i_{fppf}(X, O) for quasi-compact quasi-separated X, and that H^i_{fppf}(X, O) = H^i(X, O).

First configuration (proof lines 23672-23684): for A, f, J of the one-generator example and the associated almost blow up square, all four schemes X, X', Z, E are affine, so there is no higher cohomology of O and it remains to check that 0 -> O^{perf}(X) -> O^{perf}(X') + O^{perf}(Z) -> O^{perf}(E) -> 0 is short exact, which is the content of the corresponding flatness-chapter lemma.

Second configuration (proof lines 23686-23705): for X, X', Z, E of the two-generator example, higher cohomology of the structure sheaf vanishes on X and Z (affine), on X' (the funny blow-up lemma) and on E = P^1_Z (affine base), so once again the verification reduces to the displayed short exact sequence of sections of O^{perf}.
The same pattern is applied to the remaining configurations of the flatness chapter, completing the two conditions of the h-criterion (statement lines 23650-23656).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the h-criterion and record the two computations of cohomology of O^{perf} and of O.
For each almost blow-up square of the flatness chapter, use affineness or the funny blow-up lemma to kill the higher cohomology, reducing the check to a short exact sequence of sections of O^{perf}.
Conclude by the flatness-chapter lemmas that these short exact sequences are exact, so the criterion applies.
difficulty_reason: The lemma places the perfection O^{perf} = colim_F O of the structure sheaf of a scheme over F_p in the essential image of the pushforward from the h-topology (statement lines 23650-23656). The proof (proof lines 23658-23705) verifies the h-criterion configuration by configuration: it computes the fppf cohomology of the perfection as a filtered colimit and identifies it with the Zariski cohomology of O, then for each almost blow-up square of the flatness chapter kills the higher cohomology by affineness or by the funny blow-up lemma, reducing the check to the short exact sequence of sections of O^{perf} supplied by the flatness-chapter lemmas. H2: one criterion reduction applied to a finite list of explicit squares.
